feedback: Approved to race. The candidate is the best raced design (iteration 5, score 160.4: kp 2.5, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.3, kd 0.3, ki 0.05, weights [2,1,0,-1,-2]) with controller.line_loss changed from search_right to search_left. It reverts the kd 0.45 test. Iteration 6 (kd 0.45, score 143.1) showed oval steering_oscillation at 0.333, above the 0.3 threshold, with max_error rising on the oval (0.0604 to 0.0624) and slalom (0.0616 to 0.0679), so kd 0.3 stays. The line-loss side is the one lever not yet tested in the right-hand direction. search_right in iteration 5 left line_loss_events essentially unchanged (s-bend 2.0, slalom 1.0), so this is a clean single-field test from the best design. Approval is justified because the only alternative is another review-and-revision round, which costs two of the four remaining review runs for little extra information. The next race decides the following step. If s-bend and slalom line_loss_events fall while max_error stays at or below about 0.061 m, keep search_left and test base_speed 1.5 as the only change, since the oval finish at 1.89 s shows speed is adequate there. If line_loss_events rise above 2.0 on the s-bend, the losses are on the left side, so return to search_right and stop testing line-loss direction. If line_loss_events and max_error are both unchanged, the binding limit is steering geometry or base speed, so the next lever is base_speed 1.5 only if max_error falls below about 0.058 m and completion_time is limiting.
requested_changes: If s-bend and slalom line_loss_events fall below their iteration 5 values (2.0 and 1.0) with max_error at or below about 0.061 m: keep controller.line_loss search_left and raise controller.base_speed from 1.3 to 1.5 as the only change.

If s-bend line_loss_events rise above 2.0 with search_left: revert controller.line_loss to search_right, since iteration 5 showed the losses are not strongly one-sided and the left test has been checked.

If line_loss_events and max_error are both unchanged from iteration 5 (max_error about 0.060 to 0.062 m): keep kd 0.3 and line_loss unchanged, and test controller.base_speed 1.5 only if completion_time is limiting, otherwise test controller.ki from 0.05 to 0.1 as the only change.
